newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech real final Oct ind output up 5.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech real final Oct ind output up 5.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real definitive industrial output in October grew by 5.3 percent, year-on-year, putting output for the first 10 months of the year up 8.1 percent, year-on-year, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Tuesday.
It added that average industrial monthly wages grew, in nominal terms, 18.2 percent in October compared with a 17.0 percent rise in September, year-on- year.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT OCT/96 SEPT/96 JAN-OCT 96 OCT/95

NOTE. Preliminary estimates in brackets. The average nominal industrial wage in October was 10,202 crowns compared with 9,114 in September. The October index of real wages was up 8.7 percent, while the real wage index was 7.8 percent higher for the first 10 months of the year.
Wage results sample companies with 100 or more employees while output results include estimates of smaller firms as well.
